REVISION 1 · FEET AND INCHES
Both pieces moved 6 in to the right: 2 ft 11 in from the right wall to each.
Partition line: 4 ft 1¼ in · partition 8 ft · 2 ft 11 in.
Bed wall: 3 ft 0 in open door · 1 ft 7 in clear · bed back 8 ft · 2 ft 11 in.
Bed: 5 ft 4 in · bed 6 ft 6 in · 3 ft 8 in. The bed back shows 9 in each side.
OPEN — the ledges inside the curls come to 6⅜ in wide × 1 ft 4½ in deep. That holds a phone
and a slim lamp, not a nightstand: a 6 ft 6 bed leaves only 9 in a side inside 8 ft.
ASSUMED — bed back 4 ft 6 tall, bed 6 ft 10 long, ledges 2 ft high; partition line still to be measured.
